description: Set project configuration. Currently supports phi_exempt (boolean) to disable automatic PHI detection for non-healthcare projects. Fields like step_name, task_name won't be flagged as PHI. Omit phi_exempt to read current config.

phi_exempt.description: If true, disable all PHI detection and masking for this project. For non-healthcare data only.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Defaults to the authenticated user.
